title.en: Russia warns UK will pay for supplying drones to Ukraine
title.zh: 俄罗斯就英国向乌克兰提供无人机发出警告

summary.en: Russia has issued a warning to the UK regarding its supply of drones to Ukraine. In response, a UK Ministry of Defence spokesperson stated that Britain stands "shoulder to shoulder" with Ukraine.
summary.zh: 俄罗斯就英国向乌克兰提供无人机一事向英国发出警告。英国国防部发言人回应称，英国与乌克兰“并肩作战”。

body.en:
Russia has accused the UK of "deliberately opting for an escalation of the Ukraine crisis", following confirmation that British-made drones were used in recent strikes on military and industrial targets in Russia.

"London's actions will inevitably carry consequences for which it will have to answer," the Russian embassy to the UK wrote in a statement, adding "the deeper its involvement in the conflict... the higher the price it will pay".

Ukraine has stepped up attacks on Moscow and elsewhere deep inside Russia, particularly targeting its oil refineries and logistics sites for key online retailer Wildberries.

A spokesperson for the UK Ministry of Defence (MoD) said they stood "shoulder to shoulder" with Ukraine.

"Russia should be in no doubt about the resolve of this government to stand against Russian aggression, in Ukraine and against the UK and our allies," the spokesperson said.

Russia has threatened the UK in the past over its role in providing Ukraine with drone technology, as well as Storm Shadow missiles. In its statement, the Russian embassy did not elaborate on the type of threat Moscow was considering.

However, the latest phase of the war has directly affected Russia's domestic fuel supplies and dented the Russian economy.

The Ministry of Defence said the UK was "committed to providing the equipment Ukraine needs to defend itself against [Russian President Vladimir] Putin's illegal invasion".

Ukraine has also been able to use home-grown drone and missile technology in recent weeks, including its FP-5 Flamingo cruise missile.

Hundreds of drones have been launched by Ukrainian forces towards the Moscow region in the past two days alone. Regional governor Andrey Vorobyov said on Tuesday that a 10-year-old girl was hurt and a Wildberries warehouse was damaged.

Two British companies are known to have built drones supplied to Kyiv. A military source confirmed to the BBC that UK drones had been used in the attacks, which are said to have caused more than £35bn in economic damage.

Ukraine has repeatedly targeted Wildberries, widely described as Russia's version of Amazon, and Kyiv has said seven out of 10 of the firm's biggest logistics centres had been "disabled".

Russia launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022 and currently controls approximately a fifth of Ukrainian territory.

Russian foreign ministry spokeswoman Maria Zakharova said in 2024 that drones using UK components and configurations were used to attack Russian territory, including a fuel depot in the Kamensky District of the Rostov Region.

In the latest attacks overnight, Russian officials said some 620 drones had been flown towards the region surrounding Moscow. Russian air defences destroyed more than 180 of the drones but several people were...
body.zh: 在确认英国制造的无人机被用于袭击俄罗斯目标后，俄罗斯指责英国“故意选择升级乌克兰危机”。 俄罗斯驻英国大使馆在一份声明中写道：“英国这样做，是血腥犯罪和恐怖袭击的共犯和共犯。” 声明称，“伦敦的行动将不可避免地带来后果，必须对此做出回应”，并补充说，其卷入冲突越深，“付出的代价就越高”。 作为回应，英国国防部发言人告诉英国广播公司新闻，英国与乌克兰“肩并肩”。 这位发言人在一份声明中表示：“俄罗斯应该毫不怀疑本届政府反对俄罗斯在乌克兰的侵略、反对英国和我们的盟友的决心。” 他们补充说，英国“致力于提供乌克兰所需的设备，以抵御俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京的非法入侵”。 这些无人机由两家独立的英国公司制造，已在俄罗斯境内广泛成功地用于瞄准军事和工业目标，包括在线零售商 Wildberry 的炼油厂和仓库。 乌克兰多次针对这家被称为俄罗斯版亚马逊的公司，并表示最大的 Wildberry 物流中心中有十分之七已“瘫痪”。 一名军方消息人士向 BBC 证实，此次袭击使用了英国无人机，据称造成了超过 350 亿英镑的经济损失。 俄罗斯于2022年2月对乌克兰发动全面入侵，目前控制着乌克兰约五分之一的领土。 俄罗斯外交部发言人玛丽亚·扎哈罗娃表示，使用英国部件和配置的无人机被用来攻击俄罗斯领土，包括罗斯托夫地区卡缅斯基区的一个燃料库。 莫斯科向英国发出警告之前，乌克兰对俄罗斯发动了一波袭击，最近一次袭击发生在周一，造成 9 人死亡、23 人受伤，其中包括一名儿童。 乌克兰州长表示，周六晚上，乌克兰向俄罗斯发射了约 822 架无人机，其中 600 架瞄准莫斯科，俄罗斯首都遭受了“近期记忆中最大规模的无人机袭击之一”。俄罗斯各地报告有七人死亡。 当晚，俄罗斯对乌克兰发动袭击，造成至少7人死亡、超过39人受伤。 今年四月，国防部宣布将向乌克兰供应数万架无人机，其中包括远程打击装置，这是有史以来规模最大的一揽子计划。

reflection.en: The exchange between Russia and the UK highlights the perilous cycle of arming and warning in international conflict. Yahweh's word reminds us that those who live by the sword often face its consequences, urging reflection on the long-term impact of military aid. This dynamic underscores the need for wisdom in navigating geopolitical tensions, seeking paths...
reflection.zh: 俄罗斯和英国之间的交锋凸显了国际冲突中武装与警告的危险循环。雅伟的话语提醒我们，那些靠刀剑而活的人常常会面临其后果，促使我们反思军事援助的长期影响。这种动态强调了在处理地缘政治紧张局势时需要智慧，寻求避免暴力升级的道路。

verse.textZh: 凡动刀的，必死在刀下。

title.en: Zambia's election marred by irregularities and 'militia' arrests
title.zh: 赞比亚选举因违规行为和“民兵”被捕而受到损害

summary.en: Zambia is gripped by allegations of armed plots, intimidation and electoral interference. As President Hakainde Hichilema leads the count, concerns are growing over the state of the country's democracy.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及领导、智慧与公共责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Zambia is gripped by allegations of armed plots, intimidation and electoral interference. As President Hakainde Hichilema leads the count, concerns are growing over the state of the country's democracy.

Zambia 's government announced on Sunday that police had arrested 11 people, including six opposition figures, in a raid against "militia activity." The arrests took place on Thursday night, according to a government statement.

"The individuals in issue were found in possession of high-grade military weapons, ammunition and other materials for use in armed insurrection," it said.

Zambia's main opposition party, the National Reconciliation Party for Unity and Progress (NRPUP), said shots were fired in the raid, which took place at the home of its presidential candidate Brian Mundubile, as Agence France-Presse (AFP) reported. 

The party said it "rejects with absolute disdain the spurious and entirely false claims made by the Zambian Government that the NRPUP, its leadership or its members have been involved in insurgency, militia activity or any related conduct whatsoever."

Mundubile added that heavily ​armed ‌personnel had raided his residence after the election in what he described as an attack on his life.

He also claimed on social media that he was interrogated by army officers over videos he had released, and that he suffered mistreatment while in custody — accusations denied by the authorities.

However, the government has responded that those claims were "unsubstantiated," with outgoing Minister of Foreign Affairs Mulambo Haimbe telling DW that "the individuals that have been apprehended have been charged, first of all, and will face trial."

"So, it is not Mr Mundubile's place to make assertions on matters that will go through a court process," he stressed, adding the any actions taken by authorities made sure that the "security of the nation is not compromized" during the election process.

The arrests come amid an intensely contested election : The Electoral Commission of Zambia (ECZ) ha suspended vote counting for around six hours on Friday following reports of violence perpetrated against polling staff and the alleged theft of ballot papers.

The count resumed after the commission announced that the "security threat" had eventually been contained, AFP reported. 

Mundubile argued that this suspension created opportunities for interference and manipulation of results, while the ruling United Party for National Development (UPND) rejected the claims, saying he was attempting to undermine public confidence in the electoral process.

Opposition figures say, however, that the concerns extend beyond the pause in the vote count.

body.zh: 赞比亚饱受武装阴谋、恐吓和选举干扰的指控困扰。随着总统哈坎德·希奇莱马 (Hakainde Hichilema) 领导计票，人们对该国民主状况的担忧与日俱增。 赞比亚政府周日宣布，警方在针对“民兵活动”的突袭中逮捕了 11 人，其中包括 6 名反对派人士。根据政府声明，逮捕行动发生在周四晚上。 声明称：“涉案人员被发现持有高级军事武器、弹药和其他用于武装叛乱的材料。” 据法新社 (法新社) 报道，赞比亚主要反对党团结与进步民族和解党 (NRPUP) 表示，袭击发生在赞比亚总统候选人布赖恩·蒙杜比莱 (Brian Mundubile) 的家中，其中有人开枪。 该党表示，“绝对蔑视地拒绝赞比亚政府关于民族团结党、其领导层或其成员参与叛乱、民兵活动或任何相关行为的虚假和完全虚假的指控。” 蒙杜比莱补充说，选举后，全副武装的人员袭击了他的住所，他称这是对他生命的袭击。 他还在社交媒体上声称，他因发布的视频而受到军官审讯，并且在拘留期间遭受虐待——但当局否认了这些指控。 然而，政府回应称这些说法“未经证实”，即将离任的外交部长穆兰博·海姆贝(Mulambo Haimbe)告诉德国之声，“首先，被捕的个人已受到指控，并将面临审判。” 他强调说：“因此，蒙杜比莱先生无权对将通过法庭程序的事项做出断言。”他补充说，当局采取的任何行动都确保了选举过程中“国家安全不会受到损害”。 此次逮捕行动正值一场竞争激烈的选举之际：在有报道称投票站工作人员遭受暴力以及涉嫌盗窃选票后，赞比亚选举委员会（ECZ）于周五暂停计票约六个小时。 据法新社报道，在该委员会宣布“安全威胁”最终得到遏制后，计票工作重新开始。 蒙杜比莱辩称，这次停职为干扰和操纵结果创造了机会，而执政的国家发展联合党（UPND）则否认了这一说法，称他试图破坏公众对选举进程的信心。 然而，反对派人士表示，人们的担忧不仅仅限于暂停计票。 在一份声明中，马克比祖鲁副...

title.en: Hayden Panettiere's ex Wladimir Klitschko says family in 'profound shock and grief'

summary.en: The former heavyweight boxing champion shares a child with the Heroes actress, who died on Sunday.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Hayden Panettiere's ex-partner Wladimir Klitschko has posted an emotional tribute to the "talented" late Heroes and Nashville star, who he said has "left this world too soon".

The former world heavyweight boxing champion, who shares an 11-year-old daughter with Panettiere, said the family is going through "profound shock and grief" following her death at the age of 36.

Panettiere died in Greenville, South Carolina, on Sunday and police said there were not "any signs of foul play or suspicious circumstances".

She had struggled for years with substance abuse and audio from police dispatchers and crews said they were responding to a "cardiac arrest" and detailed their efforts to resuscitate the woman after a possible "overdose".

The Greenville County Coroner's Office said crews treated a woman in "cardiac arrest" and her autopsy showed "no signs of trauma", but that the cause of death has not been confirmed.

Klitschko posted , external that the announcement of Panettiere's "tragic death saddens me deeply".

"She left this world far too soon. Hayden was, although no longer my partner, an important part of my life and the mother of our daughter, Kaya.

"She built an incredible career through immense talent, while also facing the darker sides of a very demanding industry. Nothing will erase the times we shared or the place she had in our lives."

The pair, who met in around 2009, announced their engagement in 2013 and had their daughter together the following year. They never married.

"To our daughter Kaya, I will always speak of her mother with respect and make sure she remembers the person she was," he continued.

"I extend my deepest condolences to Hayden's parents, her friends, and her fans, who are also grieving today. Young and talented people like Hayden should not leave this world so soon.

"I ask everyone to please respect our family's feelings and privacy during this incredibly difficult time. For now, this is all I wish to say.

"Thank you to everyone who is supporting my family and expressing their sincere condolences.

Panettiere met Klitschko, who was 13 years older than her, at a party in Los Angeles when she was 19.

After their daughter was born, the actress was hit hard by postpartum depression and was drinking heavily.

Klitschko helped get her treatment but when their daughter was three, he asked her to sign over custody.

Panettiere reluctantly agreed and wrote in her autobiography, which was published earlier this year: "Not being under the same roof with her every day has been the most gut-wrenching experience of my life, and it's hard to describe the layers of emotion, including sadness, resentment, and anger I felt because of it...

"I grieve that I'm not the mother I thought I'd be, and definitely not the mother I want to...
body.zh: 海顿·潘妮蒂尔 (Hayden Panettiere) 的前伴侣弗拉基米尔·克里琴科 (Wladimir Klitschko) 向这位“才华横溢”的已故英雄和纳什维尔明星表达了情感的敬意，他说他“太早离开了这个世界”。 这位前世界重量级拳击冠军与潘妮蒂尔有一个 11 岁的女儿，她表示，在她 36 岁去世后，家人正在经历“深切的震惊和悲伤”。 潘妮蒂尔周日在南卡罗来纳州格林维尔去世，警方表示“没有任何谋杀或可疑情况的迹象”。 多年来，她一直在与药物滥用作斗争，警方调度员和工作人员的音频称，他们正在对“心脏骤停”做出反应，并详细介绍了他们在可能的“药物过量”后为这名妇女进行复苏的努力。 格林维尔县验尸官办公室表示，工作人员对一名“心脏骤停”的妇女进行了治疗，尸检显示“没有外伤迹象”，但死因尚未得到证实。 克里琴科对外发帖表示，潘妮蒂尔“悲惨死亡的消息让我深感悲痛”。 “她太早离开了这个世界。海登虽然不再是我的伴侣，但仍然是我生活的重要组成部分，也是我们女儿卡亚的母亲。 “她通过巨大的才华建立了令人难以置信的职业生涯，同时也面临着一个非常苛刻的行业的阴暗面。没有什么可以抹去我们共同度过的时光或她在我们生活中的地位。” 两人于 2009 年左右相识，于 2013 年宣布订婚，并于次年生下女儿。他们从未结婚。 “对于我们的女儿卡亚，我将永远尊重地谈论她的母亲，并确保她记得她是谁，”他继续说道。 “我向海登的父母、她的朋友和她的粉丝致以最深切的哀悼，他们今天也感到悲伤。像海登这样年轻而有才华的人不应该这么快离开这个世界。 “在这个极其困难的时刻，我请求大家尊重我们家人的感受和隐私。现在，这就是我想说的。” “感谢所有支持我的家人并表达诚挚哀悼的人。 潘妮蒂尔19岁时在洛杉矶的一次聚会上认识了比她大13岁的克里琴科。 女儿出生后，这位女演员受到产后抑郁症的严重打击，并且酗酒。 克里琴科帮助她接受了治疗，但当他们的女儿三岁时，他要求她签署监护权协议。 潘妮蒂尔无奈地同意了，并在今年早些时候出版的自传中写道：“不能每天和她在同一个屋檐下，是我一生中最痛苦的经历，我很难描述我因此而感受到的层层情感，包括悲伤、怨恨和愤怒…… “我很遗憾我没有成为我想象中的母亲，也绝对不是我想成为的母亲......

title.en: Fact check: How do I spot propaganda?
title.zh: 事实核查：如何发现宣传？

summary.en: Across the world, politicians use propaganda to manipulate the thoughts and actions of others. It's a strategy deployed by democracies and dictatorships alike. How, then, can I detect propaganda?
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及真理、分辨与诚实。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.zh: 在世界各地，政客利用宣传来操纵他人的思想和行动。这是民主国家和独裁国家都采用的策略。那么，我怎样才能发现宣传呢？ 2026年的美伊战争不仅在战场上进行，还通过社交媒体进行。 受“乐高大电影”启发的人工智能生成的动画展示了伊朗的军事力量，而另一个动画视频则描绘了超大版的美国副总统 JD 万斯像哥斯拉一样在德黑兰横冲直撞。 分享此类内容的帐户已积累了数百万次浏览量，并为人工智能时代的宣传提供了有力的例子。 它们还说明了宣传虽然远非一种新现象，但却如何随着技术的发展而不断发展。 DW 事实检查提供了一些提示来帮助您驾驭当今的信息格局。 宣传通常被描述为政府、政治家和其他行为者故意使用信息来塑造人们的信仰、态度或行为。 它依赖于选择性地呈现信息，强调某些事实，同时忽略或歪曲其他事实。 宣传不仅是俄罗斯、中国和朝鲜等专制国家进行的，也是由俄罗斯、中国和朝鲜等独裁国家进行的。它可以在世界各地找到。 不同制度之间的一个关键区别在于，独裁国家的宣传往往是高度集中和严格控制的。 在民主社会中，宣传往往更加多元化，由更广泛的参与者进行。 此外，在民主国家，自由获取替代媒体渠道和信息要简单得多。 宣传研究组织的政治学家皮尔斯·罗宾逊在接受德国之声采访时表示，宣传可以说服某人以某种特定的方式行事。 他举了美国政客如何说服公众支持2003年入侵伊拉克的例子。 罗宾逊说：“在这种情况下，他们夸大了有关大规模杀伤性武器的情报，使伊拉克看起来比实际威胁更大。” 该国从未发现大规模杀伤性武器。中央情报局提供的旨在证明其存在的图像构成了用于宣传目的的错误信息。 伊拉克战争展示了宣传的另一个主要目的：诽谤政治对手、敌对国家或被视为不受欢迎或具有威胁性的文化或价值观。 研究他政治言论的研究人员指出，他经常使用谩骂作为抹黑政治对手的手段，并使用夸大的说法来贬低无证移民。 宣传并不总是...

title.en: IVF staff accused of misleading UK parents about sperm and egg donors in northern Cyprus
title.zh: IVF工作人员被控在北塞浦路斯误导英国父母关于精子和卵子捐赠者

summary.en: IVF staff in northern Cyprus are accused of misleading UK parents, with fears that multiple children were conceived using sperm and egg donors different from those selected.
summary.zh: 北塞浦路斯的体外受精（IVF）工作人员被指控误导英国父母，人们担心有多个孩子使用的精子和卵子捐赠者并非父母所选择的。

body.en:
At least 30 children, most of them British, are feared to have been conceived by IVF treatment in northern Cyprus using the wrong sperm or egg donors.

In each case, the parents suspect they did not get the donors they had selected.

The figure is one of several new findings in a BBC investigation that, earlier this year , uncovered the first seven cases.

All the parents say they carefully selected anonymous donors based on information such as their medical history, appearance, personality, education and hobbies.

However, they have concerns the requested sperm and egg donors may not have been used in their fertility treatments.

Half of the 30 children were born from procedures at one clinic, Dogus IVF Centre.

"It's absolutely scandalous," said one of the mothers, Rachel, who recently learned that she received the wrong sperm donor from the clinic.

Three people - Dr Firdevs Uguz Tip, Dr Sevket Alpturk, and a patient co-ordinator Julie Hodson - were involved in the care of many of these patients at Dogus.

Parents suspect these members of staff may have misled them. Firdevs denies any wrongdoing and neither Alpturk or Hodson have responded to our questions.

The BBC has also now learnt that the world's largest sperm bank, Cryos International, has blacklisted Dogus clinic since 2016.

Have you been affected by the issues raised in this story? Contact the BBC at: fertilityinvestigation@bbc.co.uk

In northern Cyprus - a territory where European Union laws do not apply and which is only legally recognised by Turkey - clinics are loosely regulated and promise patients low prices, high success rates and a wide choice of sperm and egg donors.

The Turkish-occupied territory is one of the most popular destinations for British people seeking fertility treatment abroad.

We first revealed the emerging scandal in March where a small group of parents appeared to have been misled about donors.

Responding to the allegations, the territory's Ministry of Health said it had launched an official investigation. However, it has not responded to our repeated requests for more information.

Since then, more parents have contacted us and their stories have concerning similarities.

The majority said the clinics they had used had promised them screened, healthy donors from Western Europe, but that they had become suspicious after their children were born.

Eleven of the 30 children have now taken commercial DNA tests which show they have inherited genetic ancestry from Turkey or surrounding countries.

The majority of the children who have done DNA tests were conceived through IVF between 2012 and 2024 at Dogus clinic.

Families have been left with questions about who their children's real donors are and their medical histories.

reflection.en: This news highlights the profound importance of honesty and integrity, especially in services that shape families and lives. Yahweh's word reminds us that he detests dishonest dealings, valuing truth and transparency above all. In sensitive medical procedures like IVF, trust is paramount, and any deception can have far-reaching consequences for all involved.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻凸显了诚实和正直的深远重要性，尤其是在塑造家庭和生命的医疗服务中。雅伟的话语提醒我们，他憎恶不诚实的交易，看重真理和透明度。在像体外受精（IVF）这样敏感的医疗程序中，信任至关重要，任何欺骗都可能对所有相关方产生深远影响。

verse.textZh: 诡诈的天平为雅伟所憎恶；公平的法码为他所喜悦。

title.en: Fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in history leaves 2,300 dead in Congo
title.zh: 历史上增长最快的埃博拉疫情在刚果造成 2,300 人死亡

summary.en: The World Health Organization has said the current Ebola outbreak is on track to surpass the deadliest on record.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
The Democratic Republic of the Congo’s fast-moving Ebola outbreak has now killed over 2,300 people and become the deadliest outbreak of the disease on record in the Central African nation.

The outbreak unfolding in one of DRC's most vulnerable regions is the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak ever, with 4,945 cases including 2,325 deaths, according to government data.

It's the DRC's 17th outbreak, with a toll that has eclipsed that of the country's 2018-2020 outbreak when 2,299 deaths out of 3,481 cases were recorded.

The latest data shows 101 new cases and 33 deaths reported in the previous 24 hours. Over 1,000 people have recovered, while 730 remain in hospitals or isolation.

The outbreak has infected and killed more people at a greater speed than any other outbreak in history. The World Health Organization has said it is on track to surpass the 2014-16 Ebola outbreak in West Africa, the deadliest on record with more than 11,000 deaths.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Trish Newport, emergency coordinator with Doctors Without Borders, said the limited community engagement in the outbreak remains a key challenge.

"The community needs to be aware about the outbreak," she told The Associated Press news agency, adding that people "need to be involved in the response, and they need to know what the signs and symptoms are and what to do if they get sick. And this today is not happening in every single place where there are Ebola cases".

Starting from the first confirmed case, the outbreak reached 2,000 killed almost three times faster than in the 2014-16 outbreak.

Some families have lost up to 15 of their relatives in the epicentre, the Ituri province, Newport said.

"We rapidly need to scale up to be able to prevent more deaths from happening, more families and communities from being impacted," she added.

There are no approved vaccines or treatments for the rare Bundibugyo virus responsible for the current outbreak across six provinces in Congo's east. Trials for those are ongoing in Ituri.

Most new cases and deaths are being reported outside of the people being monitored. Challenges facing medical teams dealing with the outbreak also include strikes by some unpaid health workers, threats by rebel groups, anger from long-traumatised communities, bad roads making it difficult to reach all the affected territories, and misinformation claiming that Ebola isn’t real.

The WHO warned over the weekend that the outbreak is still moving at an "exceptional pace" ahead of efforts to track it, noting that it reached a weekly record of 579 cases and 304 deaths in the previous week.

title.en: Meta trial over social media harm to children begins
title.zh: 关于社交媒体对儿童伤害的元审判开始

summary.en: Four US states are taking Meta to court, accusing the social media giant of deliberately making Facebook and Instagram addictive for children. They're seeking damages and changes to the company's apps.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Four US states are taking Meta to court, accusing the social media giant of deliberately making Facebook and Instagram addictive for children. They're seeking damages and changes to the company's apps.

A landmark trial seeking to hold Meta accountable for the alleged harm its social media platforms cause children is set to begin in California on Tuesday.

Four US states, California, Colorado, Kentucky and New Jersey, argue the company misled the public about the safety of Instagram and Facebook and deliberately made the apps addictive for minors.

Lawyers for the states also allege Meta  is violating privacy laws  by routinely collecting data on children under 13 without their parents' consent.

The states are seeking around $200 billion (€173 billion) in damages as well as significant changes to Meta's core platforms.

They are part of a coalition of 29 states that sued the tech giant in 2023 for allegedly building addictive features into its apps.

Opening statements were set to get underway in the federal court in Oakland, a short drive from San Francisco, on Tuesday.

Among the star witnesses expected to testify during the proceedings is Meta founder and chief executive Mark Zuckerberg. 

Former Meta employee and expert witness Arturo Bejar is also expected to testify, despite the company's efforts to block his appearance.

According to court documents, lawyers for the states are to question him for three hours about Meta's safety practices and whether the company publicly misrepresented what it knew.

Eight people are serving on an advisory jury, but the final decision in the case rests with Judge Yvonne Gonzalez Rogers.

Kentucky Attorney General Russell Coleman described the case as "the largest consumer protection lawsuit in American history."

"We'll show a jury that Meta concealed what it knew about the harm its products cause young people because looking away was more profitable," he said in a statement.

"We are proud of our record in protecting teens on our platforms and the amount of effort that we've put into developing protections over the years, even before these cases were ever filed," the company said.

"We look forward to showing the judge and the jury those facts in court," it added.

The trial is set to last six to eight weeks, with a verdict expected by October.

title.en: Zambia's president wins second term with 60% of the vote
title.zh: 赞比亚总统以60%的选票赢得第二任期

summary.en: Hakainde Hichilema says he was “truly humbled” by the victory and promised to work for all Zambians.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及领导、智慧与公共责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Zambia's President Hakainde Hichilema has been re-elected for a second five-year term after securing a 60% share of the vote, the electoral commission has announced.

Hichilema's win was widely expected, with his closest challenger Brian Mundubile getting 38% of the votes cast. The remaining 12 candidates trailed far behind.

The result came after a contested process, with 55-year-old Mundubile earlier claiming victory and alleging, without providing evidence, that there had been voting irregularities.

It also followed the arrest of some leading opposition figures in a raid on Friday who the authorities accused of plotting an insurrection. Mundubile called the claim a fabrication.

In statement after being declared the winner, Hichilema, 64, said: "We are truly humbled by the trust you have placed in our hands."

He said the election showed that Zambia was a place of peace, law and order and a "democratic nation that settles our differences at the ballot box, and nowhere else".

"To those citizens who preferred the ideas presented by our opponents, we hear you, and we will continue to work for you," he added.

Hundreds of Hichilema's supporters, dressed in the red colours of his United Party for National Development (UPND) flooded the streets of the capital, Lusaka, to celebrate after the results declaration.

Zambia has a record of peaceful transfers of power. Since the return to multiparty democracy in 1991, presidential transitions have occurred through the ballot box.

Mundubile had earlier alleged there had been discrepancies between polling-station results and those officially announced and claimed military involvement at tallying centres.

On Monday, Mundubile described Friday's raid by armed personnel at his home in Lusaka saying they had knocked down the gate with an armoured vehicle, broke doors and windows and opened fire.

He denied allegations that high-grade military weapons were being stored at his home as well as the presence of any militia as the authorities had alleged.

Mulambo Haimbe, Hichilema's election agent and a senior UPND member said Mundubile's remarks regarding the incident were "not correct".

He told the BBC's Newsday programme on Tuesday that criminal charges were being put forward against those arrested.

He also said the courts would address the various matters should the opposition party challenge the election outcome.

A day after polling, the electoral commission briefly suspended counting and the announcement of results, citing reports of violence targeting polling staff and the theft of marked ballot papers in some areas.

Regional and international observers described the election day as largely peaceful and urged all sides to remain calm and respect the official process.

title.en: Indian student leader ends hunger strike after 16 days
title.zh: 印度学生领袖结束绝食16天

summary.en: Devendra Nath Mahto was part of a larger protest which began weeks ago, demanding exam reforms in Jharkhand state.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
An activist in India's eastern Jharkhand state has ended a 16-day hunger strike after the government agreed to protesters' demands to cancel a controversial recruitment exam.

However, the protesters say they will not call off demonstrations until India's premier investigative agency begins probing alleged malpractices in other recruitment exams.

Devendra Nath Mahto ended his fast in the presence of state ministers at a hospital in capital Ranchi, where he was admitted last week after his health deteriorated.

He was one of the faces of the protests, which began on 25 July after job-seekers and students alleged irregularities in government recruitment exams and demanded reforms.

Government jobs are highly sought after in India as they offer stability and security. Millions of people write these exams every year across states and nationally, often attending coaching classes, until they reach the mandated age limit.

But several exams have landed in controversies due to allegations of question papers being leaked and candidates using unfair means. Even for many who qualify, the uncertainty doesn't end as the recruitment process can drag on for years.

In Jharkhand, the protests began after last month's preliminary civil service exam results, with some candidates alleging that answer sheets shared online showed successful applicants had answered fewer questions than expected, fuelling suspicions of manipulation.

It came on the heels of a larger protest in Indian capital Delhi, which culminated in the resignation of the federal education minister , and hence put more pressure on Chief Minister Hemant Soren's government.

The state government agreed to cancel the preliminary exam days ago and announced an investigation by the state's Criminal Investigation Department (CID), which has arrested several people including the chief of the Jharkhand Public Service Commission.

But protesters had held out for the cancellation of the Jharkhand Staff Selection Commission-Combined Graduate Level (JSSC-CGL) examination and also demanded an investigation by the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI).

The chief minister told reporters that "many shocking facts are emerging" as part of the CID's investigation into the exam irregularities but did not give more details, saying that "the matter is under investigation".

He also announced that all exams conducted by private agency TSR Data Processing Private Limited (TDPL), which had won a tender, would be cancelled. He also announced an investigation into recruitment exams held since 2014 - it's not clear yet what would happen to candidates who cleared those exams if the investigation does find any irregularities.

A committee will also be set up to recommend reforms to the state's examination system.

title.en: Tupac Shakur murder trial opens as prosecutors say 'Keffe D' ordered 1996 killing
title.zh: 图帕克·沙库尔谋杀案开审，检方称‘Keffe D’下令1996年杀戮

summary.en: A trial is finally underway 30 years after rap artist Tupac Shakur was killed in a drive-by shooting. The case was long regarded as one of the nation's most prominent cold cases.
summary.zh: 说唱歌手图帕克·沙库尔被谋杀30年后，审判终于开始，此案曾被认为是美国最著名的悬案之一。

body.en:
A trial is finally underway 30 years after rap artist Tupac Shakur was killed in a drive-by shooting. The case was long regarded as one of the nation's most prominent cold cases.

The murder trial over Tupac Shakur's 1996 killing opened with prosecutors arguing that Duane "Keffe D" Davis planned the shooting .

Almost three decades after the drive-by shooting they opened their case by telling jurors the rapper was shot dead in an act of gang revenge masterminded by a mobster.

“Let’s be clear, Duane Davis did not pull the trigger. But he did plan the shooting in retaliation of the beating of his nephew,” Chief Deputy District Attorney Binu Palal said.

Davis, a one-time leader of the South Side Compton Crips gang, is charged in Clark County, Nevada, with a single count of murder using a deadly weapon.

Davis ordered the killing after his nephew, Orlando "Baby Lane" Anderson, had been beaten by a rival gang, Chief Deputy District Attorney Binu Palal told a court in Las Vegas Tuesday.

"Then, two and a half hours later... Tupac is gunned down in a drive-by shooting from a white Cadillac in an act of revenge," the prosecutor told jurors.

Palal said that Davis —  who has been dubbed by the authorities as a "shot caller" — did not pull the trigger but "he did plan the shooting in retaliation of the beating of his nephew".

Palal went on to tell the jury: "Remarkably, you will learn that from Duane Davis himself," referring to Davis' previous interviews with law enforcement and the media, as well as his autobiography, where the accused describes Shakur's killing.

Davis said in the interviews and his 2019 memoir, "Compton Street Legend," that he was riding in the car from which Shakur was shot.

In an interview with a federal task force probing another killing, Davis spoke of the Shakur shooting. He described handing a gun to the men in the backseat of the white Cadillac that fired on the rapper's black BMW.

On Tuesday, prosecutors played audio of Davis explaining the moment Shakur was shot.

Representing Davis, attorney Michael Sanft called the prosecution's narrative "fiction" during the defense's opening statement.

Sanft said prosecutors had no real proof that his client was culpable. He said that after 30 years a police investigation has repeatedly failed to turn up a definitive version of events.

"Just look at ‌the actual facts. What facts do you have to support any of what Keffe D said in any of his interviews or the book?" Sanft told the jury.

Sanft further said the accounts he gave in interviews and his memoir ccould not be corroborated.

title.en: Iran to go 'full offensive' if diplomacy fails as Trump threatens to bomb Oman
title.zh: 伊朗称若外交失败将“全面进攻”，特朗普威胁轰炸阿曼

summary.en: Iran has stated it will launch a "full offensive" if diplomatic efforts fail, while separately negotiating an agreement with Oman regarding the management of the Strait of Hormuz. The statement comes amidst threats from former President Trump to bomb Oman.
summary.zh: 伊朗表示，如果外交努力失败，它将采取“全面攻势”，同时正与邻国阿曼就霍尔木兹海峡的管理问题进行谈判。此前，前总统特朗普曾威胁要轰炸阿曼。

body.en:
Iran will shift to a "fully offensive" military posture because efforts to negotiate a permanent end to its war with the United States have stalled, as the US ruled out extending a temporary ceasefire agreement.

Progress towards peace talks and a resumption of oil tanker traffic through the strategic Strait of Hormuz has ground to a halt, with no sign that the warring parties are moving towards ending the conflict that the US and Israel launched with attacks on Iran on 28 February.

"Iranian entities must be prepared to escalate tensions in the Strait of Hormuz and wider region, as Iran will be ready to make decisions and take action on difficult decisions," a senior Iranian official told Reuters news agency.

The official added that Iran would conduct a "timely and precise" military attack to break the US naval blockade if diplomacy failed.

Monday marked the day Iran and the US were expected to reach a final peace agreement under a memorandum of understanding signed in June aimed at ending the war.

Signed on 17 June, the MoU set a 60-day timeframe for the US and Iran to reach a broader deal on Iran's nuclear program and US sanctions.

The agreement, which declared the "immediate and permanent termination of military operations on all fronts", quickly unravelled over a dispute about control of the Strait of Hormuz, the narrow waterway through which a fifth of global oil and liquefied natural gas flowed before the war.

Asked by reporters on Monday if the US was seeking to extend June's interim agreement, US President Donald Trump said no.

Iran said point 5 of the MoU gave it the right to manage the strait, which it shares with Oman, while the US rejected that interpretation. Hostilities resumed as Iran began firing on vessels it said were trying to sail through Hormuz on an unapproved route, and Trump said on 7 July that the pact was "over".

"Within the short period of a few weeks set by Iran, all the agreement's provisions must be implemented by the US. This is a precondition for further negotiations with the US," the Iranian official told Reuters, adding that mediators would share Iran's deadline with the US and regional countries.

Iran has been negotiating separately with its neighbour across the strait, Oman, to manage Hormuz, seen as a key component of a wider deal, and says it is close to an agreement, although progress has been slow.

Trump threatened to bomb Oman if it "gets in the way" of a US deal with Iran on the Strait of Hormuz and called for Iran to surrender.

summary.en: California, home to many billionaires, is preparing for a vote on a proposed wealth tax.

body.en:
In November, California will vote on a proposal to levy a one-off 5 per cent tax on the wealth of all billionaires in the state.

Google co-founder and billionaire Sergey Brin has already spent US$100 million on political donations to a group opposing the tax. Brin is hoping to avoid a potential tax bill of US$13 billion, a return of roughly 130-to-1 if that investment is successful.

Advocates of the billionaire tax claim it would raise US$100 billion in revenue, to be allocated directly to state-funded healthcare, food assistance and public education.

Supporters of the union-backed proposal also highlight that most billionaires currently pay lower marginal rates of tax than the average worker, and that the revenue is desperately needed to fill gaps in funding created by US President Donald Trump’s cuts to Medicaid.

Its critics, which include California’s Democratic Governor Gavin Newsom, argue the measure will drive billionaires and their tax revenue to leave the state.

Similar measures targeting the ultrawealthy are currently under consideration around the world.

In New York, Mayor Zohran Mamdani has proposed a 2 per cent income tax increase for those earning over US$1 million, and passed a property surcharge tax on second homes. Other US states — including Washington state, Maine and Minnesota — have passed or are considering similar income or wealth tax measures.

In the United Kingdom, a group of 120 millionaires have launched a “Proud to Pay” campaign asking the government to levy an additional 2% tax on wealth over £10 million.

Behind the public discussion of California’s billionaire tax lies a much deeper debate about spiralling global inequality.

Recent data from the US shows the share of economic output flowing to workers has dropped to a record low of 52.9 per cent in 2026. This means for every US$100 the economy produces, workers take home US$52.90 in pay, the smallest share since records began in 1947.

Conversely, the wealth of billionaires has accelerated rapidly. As of 2026, Forbes reports a global record 3,428 billionaires.

Perhaps most symptomatically, in June Elon Musk briefly became the world’s first trillionaire after the public launch of SpaceX. His wealth now sits at around US$800 billion.

Some blame globalisation for this explosion of inequality, but there are two other important related factors to consider as well.

The first is the global decline of the trade union movement. With union membership and power declining around the world, the ability of workers to negotiate for better wages has declined.

title.en: UAE economy: On the brink or bouncing back?
title.zh: 阿联酋经济：处于边缘还是反弹？

summary.en: On the one hand, the UAE economy is suffering due to the Iran war, as residents leave and tourists cancel plans. On the other hand, UAE authorities insist recovery is underway. What's really going on?
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及管家责任、供应与公共福祉。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
On the one hand, the UAE economy is suffering due to the Iran war, as residents leave and tourists cancel plans. On the other hand, UAE authorities insist recovery is underway. What's really going on?

In July, authorities in the United Arab Emirates made a headline-grabbing offer: If UAE residents could entice visitors there between July and October this year, the residents would qualify for a package of perks worth around $800. That was even though most foreign governments are still cautioning their citizens against travel to the UAE due to the Iran war.

After Israel and the US began launching strikes at Iran at the end of February, Iran responded by attacking US allies in the region, including the UAE. As a result, hotel occupancy in the emirate of Dubai plummeted , with rooms going from 80% full to only around 10% occupied.

Since then, some UAE hotels have closed prematurely for planned renovations and other five-star resorts have enticed UAE residents for "staycations" in luxury accommodation with a 50% discount.

Out of around 11.8 million people in the UAE , up to about 10.4 million are non-nationals . These locals run the gamut from millionaires enjoying their tax-free status in the UAE to expats who work on building sites or as cleaners and send their wages to family back home.

Many wealthier individuals with security concerns left when Iranian missiles began flying overhead. To ensure they return after the war, the UAE has said it will take a more flexible approach to rules around tax residency. That is, individuals can be out of the country for longer and not worry about losing their UAE tax status.

The New York Times has reported on the difficult situation that many of the lower-paid foreigners find themselves in as work in hospitality and tourism evaporates. Reporters in Dubai said they had seen individuals going door-to-door looking for work.

The UAE also put together a package worth around $680 million (€587 million) to help affected sectors — this included exempting hotels, restaurants and some private schools from municipality costs or delaying licensing fees.

There have been many more worrying indicators, though. Analysts predict that foreign direct investment in the Gulf states will drop and gross domestic product fall for the first time since the COVID-19 pandemic.

"Although tensions have calmed, the latent risk of a regional conflict reigniting will underpin investor wariness for the remainder of the year," the Economist Intelligence Unit warned in a July 31 briefing .

Employers said they were planning to cut jobs and didn't expect to make new hires, and inflationary pressure, due to things like the blockage of the Strait of Hormuz , meant raw materials and imports of all kinds were rising...
body.zh: 一方面，阿联酋经济因伊朗战争而受到影响，居民离开、游客取消计划。另一方面，阿联酋当局坚称复苏正在进行中。究竟发生了什么？ 今年 7 月，阿拉伯联合酋长国当局提出了一项引人注目的提议：如果阿联酋居民能够在今年 7 月至 10 月期间吸引游客前往那里，那么该居民将有资格获得价值约 800 美元的一揽子福利。尽管如此，由于伊朗战争，大多数外国政府仍然警告其公民不要前往阿联酋。 以色列和美国2月底开始对伊朗发动打击后，伊朗的回应是攻击美国在该地区的盟友，包括阿联酋。结果，迪拜酋长国的酒店入住率直线下降，客房入住率从 80% 降至仅 10% 左右。 此后，一些阿联酋酒店因计划翻修而提前关闭，其他五星级度假村则以 50% 的折扣吸引阿联酋居民在豪华住宿中“居家度假”。 在阿联酋约 1,180 万人中，约有 1,040 万人是非国民。这些当地人的范围广泛，从在阿联酋享受免税地位的百万富翁到在建筑工地工作或担任清洁工并将工资寄给家乡家人的外籍人士。 当伊朗导弹开始从上空飞过时，许多有安全顾虑的富裕人士离开了。为了确保他们在战后返回，阿联酋表示将采取更灵活的方法来制定有关税收居住权的规则。也就是说，个人可以离开该国更长时间，而不必担心失去阿联酋的纳税身份。 《纽约时报》报道称，随着酒店业和旅游业的工作消失，许多低收入外国人发现自己陷入了困境。迪拜的记者表示，他们看到有人挨家挨户寻找工作。 阿联酋还制定了价值约 6.8 亿美元（5.87 亿欧元）的一揽子计划来帮助受影响的行业，其中包括免除酒店、餐馆和一些私立学校的市政费用或推迟收取许可费。 不过，还有许多更令人担忧的指标。分析师预测，海湾国家的外国直接投资将下降，国内生产总值 (GDP) 将出现自 COVID-19 大流行以来的首次下降。 经济学人智库在 7 月 31 日的简报中警告说：“尽管紧张局势已经平息，但地区冲突重新爆发的潜在风险将在今年剩余时间内增强投资者的警惕性。” 雇主们表示，他们正计划裁员，预计不会招聘新员工，而由于霍尔木兹海峡封锁等原因，通胀压力意味着原材料和各类进口都在上涨……

body.en:
Hayden Panettiere, star of popular television series including Heroes and Nashville, has died. She was 36.

Panettiere’s father, Skip, announced the actor’s death in a statement provided to the US network ABC News on Monday.

"It is with profound sadness that we share the tragic passing of our beloved Hayden. She was an incredible light and a force of nature who brought immeasurable love and joy to all who knew her — and to the millions who watched her onscreen," his statement said.

No cause of death was announced, and a publicist for Panettiere did not immediately respond to an email from the Associated Press (AP).

Panettiere, who would have turned 37 this week, began her career as a child actor in commercials and soap operas.

Her role as a cheerleader with superpowers in Heroes propelled her to fame in 2006, with the series revolving around the mantra "Save the cheerleader, save the world."

"I think Heroes is really hot because it’s just a really great combination of everything that people love — they love reality, they love sci-fi and things like X-Men where they get to dream of something bigger," Panettiere told AP in 2008.

"And at the core of it are these human stories that people can relate to, very rugged. And it’s just grabbed everyone in every age group."

She went on to win three Teen Choice Awards for that role and was a Grammy Award nominee for a children’s spoken word album recorded a few years after the release of the animated movie A Bug’s Life.

Panettiere later played a brash country upstart opposite Connie Britton on Nashville, which aired on US network ABC for four seasons before being cancelled and revived on CMT.

She did her own singing in the show, which scored some hits on country charts, spawned US tours and earned Panettiere two supporting actress Golden Globe nominations.

Panettiere had 11 songs recorded for Nashville appear on Billboard’s Hot Country Songs charts during the show’s run, including two featuring Britton.

Panettiere's younger brother, Jansen, who was also an actor, died of a heart condition in 2023, at age 28.

She had been open about her struggles with alcohol addiction and depression, including after the birth of her daughter with Ukrainian boxer Wladimir Klitschko in 2014.

In an interview with podcaster Jay Shetty after her memoir came out in May, Panettiere talked about the custody arrangement for her 11-year-old daughter, who lives full-time with Klitschko in Ukraine.

title.en: China censors public mourning as it holds former premier's funeral
title.zh: 中国在举行前总理葬礼时审查公众哀悼活动

summary.en: While hailing Zhu’s legacy, authorities are wary that the nostalgia could lead to criticisms of Xi’s rule.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自中国栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Flags at government sites are flying at half-mast and security vehicles are parked in the heart of Beijing, as China mourns former Premier Zhu Rongji.

Zhu died of an illness last week at 97 and was cremated at a funeral in Beijing on Tuesday. The ceremony, attended by senior leaders including President Xi Jinping, was kept low-key. No footage has been released.

Zhu, who served as China's premier from 1998 to 2003, is remembered as one of the country's most important economic reformers.

While hailing the late premier as a "loyal" party member, the Chinese state is also wary that public mourning for his era of reform can easily turn into veiled criticisms of the current government under Xi.

Xi was among the leaders who had visited Zhu in hospital or sent condolences after his death, Chinese state media reported on Tuesday. Others included incumbent premier Li Qiang and ex-president Hu Jintao.

After his death, state media described Zhu as an "outstanding member of the Chinese Communist Party" and a "time-tested and loyal Communist fighter".

He was cremated at Babaoshan Revolutionary Cemetery, an exclusive resting place for high-ranking officials and other prominent figures.

Meanwhile, online, posts about Zhu have been contained and censored - including an essay written by economist Zhao Jian, which remembered Zhu's era as a time when people were "properly poor" but saw a clear future ahead.

"There were no smartphones then, no short-form videos and no screens filled by the purveyors of anxiety," he wrote.

"The sky was blue, life moved slowly and people could say what they really thought."

The party has long been fearful of public reaction to deaths of senior officials and public figures.

The deaths of former premier Zhou Enlai in 1976 and former CCP general secretary Hu Yaobang in 1989 prompted widespread outpourings of grief that morphed into protests.

Zhu died just days before the Communist Party leadership gathered to commemorate the birth centenary of President Jiang Zemin, who died in 2022.

The death of Zhu and Jiang, two prominent leaders from the same era, has prompted a wave of nostalgia among many Chinese people for a time when the country looked as if it was going in a different direction - when it appeared that it may open to the world and allow more freedom for its people.

Previously purged under Mao Zedong's regime, Zhu was brought back into the fold after Mao's death in 1976.

Zhu served as premier alongside Jiang Zemin, who became Communist Party chief in 1989 and president in 1993.

The two men served alongside each other at the top of China's leadership from 1998 to 2003, leading China through an era of rapid economic growth and entry into global trade.

title.en: Indonesia neutrality tested by joint naval drill with China

summary.en: Indonesia's nonaligned foreign policy is being scrutinized after its limited participation in a low-level naval exercise with China near Taiwan, raising international concerns.
summary.zh: 印度尼西亚的有限参与与中国海军在台湾附近举行的一次低级别海军演习，引发了国际关注，使其不结盟的外交政策受到审视。

body.en:
Indonesia maintains a nonaligned foreign policy, but Jakarta's limited participation in a low-level naval exercise with China's navy near Taiwan has raised concerns.

On August 12, an Indonesian frigate briefly joined a naval exercise with China's People's Liberation Army Navy (PLAN) in waters off Taiwan's east coast, with Taipei asking Jakarta for a reason why it joined the drill.

Indonesian Navy frigate KRI I Gusti Ngurah Rai joined the PLAN guided-missile frigate Honghe for what Jakarta described as a "passing exercise." The maneuvers took place during Taiwan's annual Han Kuang military drill. 

An Indonesian Ministry of Foreign Affairs spokesperson said they were fully aware that the exercise's location "made it particularly sensitive," but stressed that its vessel's presence "was simply part of its transit route back to Indonesia." According to the Taipei Times , the Indonesian vessel was returning from Vladivostok, Russia after an exercise with the Russian navy.  

Taiwan's Mainland Affairs Council condemned Beijing's "provocation" after China announced the drill on August 11. Taipei also requested "further details from the Indonesian government" from its Ministry of Foreign Affairs.  

Beijing considers Taiwan to be Chinese territory and has vowed to "reunite" the self-ruled island with the mainland, by using force if necessary . The People's Liberation Army has ratcheted up pressure on Taiwan with frequent military exercises around the island, especially since former US House Speaker Nancy Pelosi visited Taipei in 2022.

Amid reactions from Taipei and Washington, the Indonesian Navy stated that its activities with the Chinese Navy were "not warfighting activities in nature" and "not intended as combat training."

Ying-Yu Lin, an associate professor at Taiwan's Tamkang University Graduate Institute of International Affairs and Strategic Studies, told DW that the Chinese exercise with Indonesia had little tactical significance.

"It wasn't as practical as a joint maritime drill, but China wanted to claim its capability in the waters," he said.

However, Ratih Kabinawa, a visiting research fellow at the Japan Institute of International Affairs focusing on Taiwan-Indonesia ties, told DW that regardless of the significance of the drills, Indonesia should have expected some reaction from Taiwan .

"Like it or not, Indonesia is now dragged into this kind of geopolitical gambit," she said.

Kabinawa added that passing exercises were among the lowest-level naval activities yet used by China to justify its intimidation of Taiwan.

"Indonesia must also exercise caution in this regard," she said, adding that Jakarta should "not to be too naive," to assume that its participation in a "regular exercise" with China would not cause concern...
body.zh: 印度尼西亚维持不结盟的外交政策，但雅加达有限地参加了在台湾附近与中国海军举行的低级别海军演习，这引起了人们的担忧。 8月12日，一艘印度尼西亚护卫舰短暂参加了与中国人民解放军海军在台湾东海岸附近海域举行的海军演习，台北向雅加达询问其参加演习的原因。 印度尼西亚海军护卫舰 KRI I Gusti Ngurah Rai 与中国海军导弹护卫舰红河号一起进行了雅加达所说的“穿越演习”。此次演习是在台湾一年一度的汉光军演期间进行的。 印度尼西亚外交部发言人表示，他们完全意识到演习地点“使其特别敏感”，但强调其船只的存在“只是其返回印度尼西亚的过境路线的一部分”。据《台北时报》报道，这艘印尼舰艇在与俄罗斯海军演习后正从俄罗斯符拉迪沃斯托克返回。 中国8月11日宣布演习后，台湾陆委会谴责北京的“挑衅”。台北还要求外交部“提供更多细节”。 北京认为台湾是中国领土，并誓言要让这个自治岛屿与大陆“统一”，必要时会使用武力。特别是自美国前众议院议长南希·佩洛西 2022 年访问台北以来，解放军在台湾频繁进行军事演习，加大了对台湾的压力。 在台北和华盛顿的反应中，印度尼西亚海军表示，其与中国海军的活动“本质上不是战斗活动”，并且“无意进行战斗训练”。 台湾淡江大学国际事务与战略研究所副教授林英宇告诉德国之声，中国与印尼的演习没有什么战术意义。 他说：“这不像联合海上演习那么实际，但中国希望宣示其在该海域的能力。” 不过，日本国际问题研究所研究台印尼关系的客座研究员拉蒂·卡比纳瓦(Ratih Kabinawa)告诉德国之声，无论演习的意义如何，印尼都应该预料到台湾会做出一些反应。 “无论你喜欢与否，印度尼西亚现在都被拖入了这种地缘政治游戏，”她说。 卡比纳瓦补充说，通过演习是中国迄今为止用来证明其恐吓台湾的正当理由的最低级别的海军活动之一。 她说：“印度尼西亚在这方面也必须保持谨慎。”她补充说，雅加达“不要太天真”，认为参加与中国的“定期演习”不会引起担忧……

reflection.en: Indonesia's efforts to maintain neutrality amidst regional tensions highlight the constant challenge of living peaceably with all nations. Even limited engagements can test a nation's commitment to nonalignment and raise complex questions about its role in global affairs. Yahweh calls us to pursue peace as far as it depends on us, navigating relationships...
reflection.zh: 印度尼西亚在区域紧张局势中努力保持中立，这突显了与所有国家和平相处的持续挑战。即使是有限的参与，也可能考验一个国家对不结盟政策的承诺，并引发对其在全球事务中角色的复杂疑问。雅伟呼召我们尽力追求和平，以智慧和正直来处理各种关系。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: After Hormuz, China looks to the promise – and peril – of the Arctic’s ‘ice silk road’
title.zh: 继霍尔木兹海峡之后，中国着眼于北极“冰上丝绸之路”的机遇与风险

summary.en: China has initiated the first regular shipping transits through the Arctic's northern sea route, aiming to establish an "ice silk road." This new maritime path, however, raises significant concerns regarding its potential environmental impact and geopolitical implications.
summary.zh: 中国已开通北极航线的首次定期运输，旨在建立一条“冰上丝绸之路”。然而，这条新的海上航线在环境影响和地缘政治方面引发了重大担忧。

body.en: China has established the first scheduled transit through the northern sea route, but questions remain over the environmental and political risks When Marco Rubio suggested that the world should look to new shipping lanes to bypass the logjammed strait of Hormuz, it’s unlikely he had the Arctic’s northern sea route in mind. And yet in recent months the promise of this 5,500km channel – cleaved through frozen seas by nuclear-powered icebreakers and illuminated by a sun that never dips below the Arctic horizon – has grown. Continue reading...
body.zh: 中国已经建立了第一条通过北方海路的定期过境航线，但环境和政治风险仍然存在问题。当马可·卢比奥建议世界应该寻求新的航道以绕过堵塞的霍尔木兹海峡时，他不太可能想到北极的北方海路。然而近几个月来，这条 5,500 公里长的航道 — — 由核动力破冰船劈开冰冻的海洋，并由永远不会低于北极地平线的太阳照亮 — — 的前景越来越大。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The pursuit of new trade routes like the Arctic's "ice silk road" highlights humanity's drive for progress and efficiency. Yet, as the story notes, such ventures also carry significant environmental and political risks that demand careful consideration. Yahweh's wisdom encourages us to foresee danger and take precautions, rather than rushing headlong into...
reflection.zh: 像北极“冰上丝绸之路”这样的新贸易路线的开辟，彰显了人类对进步和效率的追求。然而，正如报道所指出的，此类项目也伴随着重大的环境和政治风险，需要我们审慎考量。雅伟的智慧鼓励我们预见危险并采取预防措施，而不是为了短期利益而贸然陷入潜在的危机。

verse.textEn: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.
verse.textZh: 通达人见祸藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。

title.en: A fake website and a deluge of CVs: the Australian firm embroiled in an FBI probe into alleged Chinese espionage
title.zh: 虚假网站与大量简历：澳大利亚公司卷入联邦调查局对涉嫌中国间谍活动的调查

summary.en: An Australian firm has been caught up in an FBI investigation into alleged Chinese espionage, involving a fake consultancy website that impersonated the Brisbane company. This fake site was among 13 websites seized by the US Department of Justice.
summary.zh: 一家澳大利亚公司卷入联邦调查局对涉嫌中国间谍活动的调查，其中涉及一个冒充这家布里斯班公司的虚假咨询网站。这个虚假网站是美国司法部查获的13个网站之一。

body.en: Exclusive: Fake consultancy impersonating Brisbane firm online is one of 13 websites seized by the US Department of Justice Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast When the first emails arrived, they were easily dismissed as spam. But as strangers continued to boast about their defence and security credentials, they became impossible to ignore. From mid-2025, a small Australian consultancy firm called Horizzen started receiving emails and strange calls from people applying for vague jobs in the United States. Continue reading...
body.zh: 独家：在线冒充布里斯班公司的虚假咨询公司是美国司法部查获的 13 个网站之一 关注我们的澳大利亚新闻直播博客以获取最新更新 获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客 当第一批电子邮件到达时，它们很容易被视为垃圾邮件而被忽略。但随着陌生人继续吹嘘他们的国防和安全资历，他们变得不可能被忽视。从 2025 年中期开始，一家名为 Horizzen 的澳大利亚小型咨询公司开始收到人们在美国申请模糊工作的电子邮件和奇怪的电话。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This news highlights how deception, even when elaborately crafted, often has a limited lifespan. While falsehoods may initially mislead, their true nature is eventually revealed, as seen in the seizure of these fake websites. Yahweh's word reminds us that truth ultimately prevails, and deceit cannot endure indefinitely.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻揭示了欺骗，即使精心策划，也往往寿命有限。虚假信息可能一时蒙蔽，但其真实面目终将被揭露，正如这些虚假网站被查获一样。雅伟的话语提醒我们，真理最终会得胜，谎言无法永远持续。

verse.textEn: Truthful lips endure forever, but a lying tongue lasts only a moment.
verse.textZh: 口吐真言，永远坚立；舌说谎话，只存片时。

title.en: How to buy a ‘mega-dinghy’: the perilous new model of Channel crossing
title.zh: 如何购买“巨型橡皮艇”：危险的英吉利海峡偷渡新模式

summary.en: The Guardian China reports on the alarming trend of large dinghies, capable of carrying hundreds, being used for perilous Channel crossings. The article investigates the supply chain for these vessels, noting that large orders are readily fulfilled by manufacturers.
summary.zh: 《卫报》中国版报道称，载有数百人的大型充气艇被用于危险的英吉利海峡偷渡，这一趋势令人担忧。文章调查了这些大型船只的来源，指出制造商可以轻松满足大批量订单。

body.en: Boats carrying hundreds of people are a clear and alarming trend. But where do such large vessels come from? Providing a large dinghy for use in the choppy seas of western Europe was not a problem, as long as the order was for more than 20 vessels, they said. The sales manager at the Chinese company even had an online brochure for an undercover Guardian reporter, posing as a prospective client, to peruse. They had a production capacity of 500 boats a month and, yes, it was possible to get even bigger ones for the right price. They could do a seven or even an eight-metre military-style dinghy for $1,678 (£1,238) a boat, without the engines, but that would be lacking CE certification, the mandatory mark that shows a product meets EU health and safety requirements. Additional reporting by Lyndon Li Continue reading...
body.zh: 载有数百人的船只是一个明显且令人震惊的趋势。但这么大的船只从哪里来呢？他们表示，只要订单超过 20 艘，提供一艘在西欧波涛汹涌的海域使用的大型小艇就不成问题。这家中国公司的销售经理甚至还为一位冒充潜在客户的卫报卧底记者准备了一份在线手册供其细读。他们的生产能力为每月 500 艘船，是的，有可能以合适的价格获得更大的船。他们可以以每艘 1,678 美元（1,238 英镑）的价格制造一艘七米甚至八米长的军用小艇，不带发动机，但这将缺乏 CE 认证，这是表明产品符合欧盟健康和安全要求的强制性标志。林登·李的补充报道继续阅读...

reflection.en: This report on the supply of vessels for perilous journeys reminds us of the vulnerable individuals seeking safety and new beginnings. Yahweh calls us to recognize His presence in those who are marginalized and in desperate need. Our compassion for 'the least of these' reflects our love for Him.
reflection.zh: 这篇关于用于危险旅程的船只供应的报道，提醒我们那些寻求安全和新生活的弱势个体。雅伟呼召我们要在那些被边缘化和极度需要的人身上认出祂的存在。我们对“这些最小的弟兄”的怜悯，反映了我们对祂的爱。

verse.textEn: Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me.
verse.textZh: 我实在告诉你们，这些事你们既做在我这弟兄中一个最小的身上，就是做在我身上了。

title.en: The Fauci hearing was painful to watch. But we need answers on Covid-19’s origin| David Relman
title.zh: 福奇听证会令人痛苦，但我们需要新冠病毒起源的答案 | 大卫·雷尔曼

summary.en: Despite recent congressional hearings, understanding the origin of Covid-19 remains elusive, with a microbiologist observing a deterioration in public discourse surrounding the issue.
summary.zh: 尽管近期国会举行了听证会，但了解新冠病毒的起源仍然困难重重，一位微生物学家指出，围绕这一问题的公共讨论正在恶化。

body.en: Despite the recent hearings in Congress, we seem to be even further from the goal of understanding Covid-19’s origin’s than we have ever been As a microbiologist and infectious disease clinician, it has been tough to watch the recent devolution of public discourse on Covid-19 origins. It has been especially difficult for me to read the comments of Anthony Fauci about the origins debate in his now-public diary . And it has been painful to watch the televised spectacle hosted by the US senator Rand Paul on 29 July involving a hostile interrogation of Fauci. Despite many early pleas, including my own , for a dispassionate, objective assessment of what we know, don’t know and need to know about Covid-19 origins, we seem to be even further from this goal now than we have ever been – plagued by politicization, polarization and illogical thinking. David Relman is a professor of medicine and microbiology at Stanford University. He was an inaugural member of the US National Science Advisory Board for Biosecurity and president of the Infectious Diseases Society of America Continue reading...
body.zh: 尽管最近在国会举行了听证会，但我们似乎距离了解 Covid-19 起源的目标比以往任何时候都更远。作为一名微生物学家和传染病临床医生，很难看到最近公众关于 Covid-19 起源的讨论的转移。对我来说，阅读安东尼·福奇在他现已公开的日记中关于起源争论的评论尤其困难。 7 月 29 日美国参议员兰德·保罗主持的电视节目对福奇进行敌意审讯，令人感到痛苦。尽管包括我自己在内的许多人早期呼吁对我们所知道、不知道和需要了解的 Covid-19 起源进行冷静、客观的评估，但我们现在似乎比以往任何时候都离这个目标更远——受到政治化、两极分化和不合逻辑思维的困扰。大卫·雷尔曼是斯坦福大学医学和微生物学教授。他是美国国家生物安全科学咨询委员会的首任成员和美国传染病学会主席继续阅读...

reflection.en: The struggle to understand complex issues like the origin of Covid-19, especially amidst contentious public discourse, reminds us of the wisdom in seeking thorough examination. Proverbs 18:17 suggests that true understanding emerges only after hearing all sides and carefully scrutinizing every claim. This calls for patience and a commitment to truth beyond...
reflection.zh: 在围绕新冠病毒起源等复杂问题展开的激烈公共讨论中，我们努力寻求理解，这提醒我们彻底审查的重要性。箴言18:17指出，真正的理解只有在听取各方意见并仔细审查每项主张之后才能浮现。这要求我们超越初步印象，以耐心和对真理的承诺，从而走向更清晰的道路。

verse.textEn: In a lawsuit the first to speak seems right, until someone comes forward and cross-examines.
verse.textZh: 先诉情由的，似乎有理；但邻舍来到，就察出实情。

title.en: ‘TikTok wouldn’t open at all’: Taiwan simulates an internet blackout, with an eye on China threat
title.zh: “抖音完全打不开”：台湾模拟互联网中断，以应对中国威胁

summary.en: Taiwan conducted its first internet blackout simulation, prompted by concerns over the security of its undersea cables, which are vital for its digital connectivity. During the exercise in Taipei, air raid sirens sounded, mobile alerts pinged, and police directed people off the streets.
summary.zh: 台湾周四首次进行互联网中断模拟演习，原因是担心作为其“数字生命线”的海底电缆的安全。在台北的演习中，防空警报响起，手机警报提示音不断，警察引导人们离开街道。

body.en: Taiwan practised cutting off internet for the first time amid concerns about the safety of the undersea cables that form its ‘digital lifeline’ In Taipei, the streets swiftly empty as air raid sirens ring out and alerts ping on mobile phones. Police officers usher any stragglers into shelters, leaving the capital suddenly deserted. In cities across Taiwan, these kinds of drills are a fact of life every year , amid the growing threat posed by China across the strait, but this time there is something different. Continue reading...
body.zh: 由于担心构成其“数字生命线”的海底电缆的安全性，台湾周四首次练习切断互联网。在台北，随着空袭警报的响起和手机上的警报声，街道迅速空无一人。警察把掉队的人带进避难所，首都突然变得空无一人。在台湾各城市，随着海峡两岸中国构成的威胁日益加剧，此类演习每年都是家常便饭，但这次有所不同。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Taiwan's simulation of an internet blackout highlights the deep anxieties nations face regarding critical infrastructure and potential threats. In moments of such vulnerability and preparation, the ancient promise of Yahweh reminds us not to fear or be dismayed, for divine presence offers strength and help. This spiritual anchor can guide communities as...
reflection.zh: 台湾模拟互联网中断，凸显了各国在关键基础设施和潜在威胁面前的深层焦虑。在面对这种脆弱和准备的时刻，雅伟的古老应许提醒我们不要惧怕，也不要惊惶，因为神圣的同在提供力量和帮助。这个属灵的锚点可以指引社群应对复杂的挑战并建立韧性。

verse.textEn: So do not fear, for I am with you; do not be dismayed, for I am your God.
verse.textZh: 你不要害怕，因为我与你同在；不要惊惶，因为我是你的神。

title.en: The west turns a blind eye to Xi Jinping’s repressive regime in China | Letters
title.zh: 西方国家对习近平在中国的压制性政权视而不见 | 来信

summary.en: Jennifer Hubbard and other letter writers express concern that Western nations are ignoring China's repressive regime, particularly its 'ethnic unity' law used to suppress minorities. They argue that meaningful international diplomacy is urgently needed to address these human rights issues.
summary.zh: 詹妮弗·哈伯德及其他来信者表示，西方国家对中国压制性政权，特别是其用于压制少数民族的“民族团结”法视而不见。他们认为，急需有意义的国际外交来解决这些人权问题。

body.en: Meaningful diplomacy on an international level is well overdue, writes Jennifer Hubbard . Plus letters from Geoffrey Dixon and Jane Renton In his article on China’s latest tool for suppression of minorities, the “ethnic unity” law, Simon Tisdall seems to take it as read that western governments will continue to pay lip service to notions of human rights in China while pursuing short-term economic goals, ultimately destructive to their own productivity ( President Xi never wastes a good crisis. As Iran, Ukraine and Palestine distract the world, he tightens his grip, 8 August ). This has been the pattern since June 1989, the Tiananmen Square massacre. His faint hope that the young urban Chinese might overturn Xi’s regime is a judgment on the failure of western governments to show any foresight, integrity, effective diplomacy, joined-up thinking or action. They rely on the self-sacrifice of individuals such as Jimmy Lai , Lobga Rangzen and countless – often to us nameless – individuals who put their lives on the line while we wring our hands and weep crocodile tears. Continue reading...
body.zh: 詹妮弗·哈伯德写道，早就应该在国际层面开展有意义的外交。再加上杰弗里·迪克森和简·伦顿的来信。西蒙·蒂斯达尔在其关于中国镇压少数民族的最新工具“民族团结”法的文章中似乎认为，西方政府将继续对中国的人权观念口头上说好，同时追求短期经济目标，最终损害他们自己的生产力（习主席从来不会浪费一场好的危机。随着伊朗、乌克兰和巴勒斯坦分散了世界的注意力，他加强了控制，8月8日）。这就是1989年6月天安门广场屠杀以来的模式。他对中国城市年轻人可能推翻习近平政权的微弱希望是对西方政府未能表现出任何远见、正直、有效外交、联合思维或行动的判断。他们依赖于黎智英（Jimmy Lai）、洛布加·让赞（Lobga Rangzen）等个人的自我牺牲，以及无数（通常对我们来说无名）个人的自我牺牲，他们冒着生命危险，而我们则绞尽脑汁，流下鳄鱼的眼泪。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The call for international diplomacy to address the suppression of minorities echoes the biblical mandate to speak for those who cannot speak for themselves. title.en: Here's what's set to change as gambling and 'widow tax' reforms partly greenlit

summary.en: Australia has partially greenlit reforms to gambling laws, which will change rules for advertising, inducements, and online betting. The changes follow a deal struck between the Labor and Coalition parties.

body.en:
Contentious gambling reforms, including restrictions on incentives and a national register to opt out of online gambling ads, are set to pass after Labor and the Coalition struck a deal.

The Labor caucus approved the deal on Tuesday morning, after the government made several amendments to secure Coalition support.

Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said the reforms would protect those most at risk of harm.

"Australians will be better protected from inducements and direct marketing," he told parliament.

But gambling reform advocates have been critical of the bill, which was passed in the lower house with 96 votes to nine. It will be debated in the upper house and is expected to be passed this week.

Among them were two Coalition MPs — Pat Conaghan and Andrew Wallace — who crossed the floor and joined the independents to vote against the laws. Both have spoken out, saying the laws don't go far enough.

"I don't like gambling. The reality is $36 billion is lost on gambling each and every single year. That's $95 million a day that is lost to gambling in Australia," Wallace told News24.

"I've never crossed the floor in 10 years in my parliamentary career but I've just heard too many stories of my constituents and people across Australia who have lost everything, who have sometimes lost their lives."

The agreement between the government and Opposition means the Coalition will also support changes to the National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS) in exchange for Labor expediting a push to remove a so-called widow's tax which was part of tax changes in the May budget.

Communications Minister Anika Wells said the government had listened to the community and taken steps to address the "most toxic version of inducements".

"The reforms introduced to parliament represent the most significant reforms to online gambling in Australia’s history," she said.

"This package of reforms minimises children’s exposure to wagering advertising, takes action on predatory inducements and cracks down on illegal gambling operators."

Opposition communications spokesperson Sarah Henderson claimed the amendments were a win for the Coalition.

"Labor's bill simply did not go far enough to protect children and vulnerable Australians," she said.

The gambling reforms are the first in the three years since a landmark report by late Labor MP Peta Murphy , who called for a total phase-out of gambling ads.

A Senate committee report on the proposed changes was tabled on Monday night, criticising the government's reforms as being too little, too late.

title.en: A 'huge' trade-off: One Nation's pitch for cheaper cigarettes
title.zh: “巨大”的权衡：一国党关于降低香烟价格的提议

summary.en: One Nation's proposal to lower cigarette prices aims to curb the black market, but experts are debating whether this could undermine decades of public health efforts against smoking.
summary.zh: 澳洲一国党提出降低香烟价格以打击黑市的提议，但专家们正在讨论这是否会逆转数十年来在控烟方面取得的进展。

body.en:
One Nation leader Pauline Hanson has vowed to slash the tax on tobacco by 75 per cent and dramatically reduce the price of legal cigarettes, arguing the move would curb the booming black market.

Illicit tobacco trade in Australia has expanded rapidly since 2020. The value of illicit tobacco attempting to enter the market has soared from $1.74 billion in 2018-19 to more than $6.4 billion in 2023-24, according to Australian Taxation Office estimates.

Meanwhile, government revenue from the tobacco excise — the tax applied to legal tobacco products — has plummeted and is forecast to continue declining.

"Labor has not only lost the revenue, it has lost control of the black market in illegal tobacco," Hanson said in her announcement on Tuesday.

Hanson said her party would also pause indexation on the excise for three years, saying the policy, if passed through in full, would reduce the price of a $46.50 legal packet of cigarettes to around $21 to $22.

Tobacco is subject to a high excise to keep prices high and discourage smoking. Currently, excise duty rates increase by 5 per cent each year, in addition to routine indexation.

"This is not about encouraging smoking. It is about restoring the rule of law and breaking the black market," Hanson said.

Labor has previously resisted calls to cut the excise. On Tuesday, Treasurer Jim Chalmers said the government was not considering a cut and its focus was on compliance.

What could a policy like this accomplish? Experts have mixed views on how it would impact crime, public health and government revenue from the excise.

The use of illicit tobacco has surged in recent years, raising alarm bells for public health experts despite an overall decline in smoking rates .

Laura Hunter, CEO of the Australian Council on Smoking and Health, told SBS News making cigarettes cheaper would have "huge ramifications for the health of Australians".

"Australia now has the lowest smoking rates that we've ever recorded, and that's the result of decades of policies that are designed to make cigarettes less affordable, less available in the community, and less normalised," she said.

Hunter rejected the idea that legal tobacco prices were the primary driver of the black market, arguing its growth was being fuelled by international organised crime networks mass producing illicit tobacco.

"Our tobacco laws in Australia were never designed to combat sophisticated organised crime groups," she said.

Sydney Swans coach Dean Cox says he's "extremely disappointed" after several players were linked to a police investigation into an alleged sexual assault.

Victoria Police attended the Pullman Hotel in East Melbourne on Monday to investigate a sexual assault report in the early hours of the morning.

The Sydney Swans were staying at the hotel, having defeated Essendon at the nearby Melbourne Cricket Ground on Sunday night.

The win meant they locked in second place on the AFL ladder, guaranteeing they would play two home finals, with only an inconsequential game against 13th-placed North Melbourne remaining to complete their home-and-away season.

On Monday morning, several media outlets reported that several players had been linked to an investigation into an alleged sexual assault.

Several media outlets later reported the names of four of the five players who had reportedly spoken to police to assist their inquiries. The players were not arrested, and no charges have been laid.

SBS News has chosen not to name the players as it has not independently verified their identities.

Victoria Police issued a brief statement, confirming it was investigating a sexual assault report and the "exact circumstances are yet to be established and the investigation into the incident remains ongoing".

It provided a similarly worded updated statement on Tuesday morning, which added: "Police spoke to a number of people at the hotel; however, no one has been arrested or formally interviewed at this time."

On Tuesday morning, coach Dean Cox briefly spoke to reporters outside of the Swans' Sydney headquarters for the first time since the news broke.

"Obviously extremely disappointed with what's happened, and understand the questions and we'll update as we gather more information," Cox said.

Asked if player sanctions could be expected, Cox said: "We're working our way through everything with the AFL and the relevant parties and we'll update when we get more information."

He was also asked whether he had spoken to the players involved, saying: "We'll speak as the day unfolds."

Co-captain Callum Mills also spoke briefly to waiting media at Moore Park on Tuesday morning as he and other players started to filter into the club.

"I can't really comment. There's an investigation ongoing and we don't have the facts yet," Mills said.

The group of players reportedly drove back to Sydney from Melbourne on Monday night.

title.en: Women’s physical and mental health 'inseparable', new endometreosis research finds
title.zh: 子宫内膜异位症新研究发现女性身心健康“密不可分”

summary.en: New research has exposed an "enormous" gap in Australia's women's healthcare system.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Women living with endometriosis, ovarian cysts and hormone-related conditions are experiencing significantly higher rates of anxiety, depression and self-harm, highlighting the need for mental health support to be integrated into women’s physical healthcare.

Research published by Women's Mental Health Australia on Tuesday found almost half of women with endometriosis reported experiencing anxiety.

Women with polyendocrine metabolic ovarian syndrome experienced depression and anxiety at up to twice the rate of women without the condition.

The findings have uncovered major gaps in Australia's healthcare system, according to chief operating officer Katrina Locandro.

"The government's investing a lot in women's health at the moment ... and there is a really practical step that they could be taking to reduce that gap."

The findings indicate that physical health conditions are associated with poorer mental health.

But the greatest psychological toll is on women living with female-specific physical health conditions, including polyendocrine metabolic ovarian syndrome, a broad condition involving a hormone imbalance, irregular periods and ovarian cysts.

Women with that syndrome reported high rates of depression and anxiety, between 1.6 and 2.2 times higher than women who did not have the condition.

The disparity also extended to suicide and self-harm rates, reported by 10 per cent of women with polyendocrine metabolic ovarian syndrome and 13 per cent of women with endometriosis, compared with four per cent of women without those conditions.

The research found that one in three women are not seeking help for their mental health issues, often because of financial and stigma-related reasons.

Locandro says every woman attending a government-funded endometriosis and pelvic pain clinic should receive an integrated mental health assessment and support as a standard offering.

"We're not asking the government to build a new system, we're asking it to strengthen an existing one by recognising that women's physical and mental health are inseparable," she said.

Report co-author Bronwyn Graham said that embedding integrated mental health assessment and support into existing services would be a game-changer.

"Women are being asked to manage two separate journeys, one for their body and one for their mind, and to find their own way between them at the point they are least able to."

body.en:
As Australians look for ways to cut grocery costs, confusing food date labels could be driving people to throw out food that's still perfectly safe to eat.

New survey data from financial comparison site Finder suggests 14 per cent of Australians say they've resorted to eating expired food to save money, while 68 per cent of the 1,010 survey participants said they've taken money-saving measures to afford food.

At the same time, confusion over what "use-by" and "best-before" dates actually mean could be costing households at the other end.

OzHarvest has been campaigning for reforms to Australia's date label system, arguing that "evidence has moved on" since it was established more than two decades ago.

The food rescue organisation says date labelling is a major driver of unnecessary food waste.

Research commissioned by the group found food reaching its best-before or use-by date was the most commonly cited reason for disposal, reported by 58 per cent of high-wasting households and 44 per cent of low-waste households.

"Consumers are really confused by the difference between best-before and use-by," said RMIT associate professor Lukas Parker, who has authored research on the topic with End Food Waste Australia.

"We know it's around 50 per cent or more of people just don't know the difference," he told SBS News.

A 2021 government-backed national study estimated Australian households throw away up to $2,500 worth of food each year, with 7.6 million tonnes of food wasted annually — around 300kg per person.

The term "use-by" means the food carrying the label can only be guaranteed safe to consume until that date. Highly perishable products like fresh meat might carry this label.

A "best-before" date, on the other hand, means the product is still safe to consume after that date, but it might no longer be at its best. Products like cereals and pasta might come with a "best-before" label.

According to Food Standards Australia New Zealand, you can still eat foods for a while after the best-before date. They may have lost some quality, but they can still be sold and consumed after the best-before date has passed.

Foods cannot legally be sold after the use-by date, the food standards regulator says.

But many consumers treat both dates the same, according to OzHarvest, meaning food that's safe to eat ends up in the bin.

OzHarvest says people should trust their instincts and senses when deciding whether food past its date needs to go in the bin or is still safe to eat.

"Sniff a product, look at a product, taste it to see if it is okay," its national policy and advocacy lead Katinka Day says.

body.en:
Sweeping last-minute changes to Labor's gambling reforms, including a crackdown on inducements, have been unveiled in parliament, hours before the release of a damning report on the matter.

A Senate committee report on the proposed changes was tabled on Monday night, slamming the government's attempt to protect vulnerable people from gambling addictions as being too little, too late.

It contained criticism from the coalition, Greens and independent senator David Pocock.

The reforms were referred to the committee for an inquiry over concerns they did not adequately break the connection between betting and sport nor protect kids from gambling exposure.

"This package is not an evidence-led public health response to a public health issue," Pocock said in the report.
